shape: Multi-zone wrap (N+E gates, long counterclockwise spine)
description: Large multi-chamber room with a long counterclockwise spine connecting the north and east gates. The backbone enters at the north gate, descends through a north-bay area, sweeps west through a west spine, curves south, then wraps east through a south chamber and an east-side staging cluster before reaching the east gate. Five sub-zones branch off the spine: a north-bay clique (around kkr1vd), a far-west corner pair (vi6hmf + ycsd87), a south bulge (7ziyhi), an east-mid detour (oovqvm), and the east-staging cluster (hpk1e8 + v7es9b).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-0.11, -24.30) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, center X
portals.east: spawn_east at (24.79, 0.14) — gate on the east (high-X) side, center Z

anchors.description: north entry hub — branches into 4 north-bay detours + the SW spine (matches kkr1vd)
SW spine step 1 — first west move (matches 71lkbz)
west hub — branches into the far-west corners (matches 5qvmjd)
far west NW corner — dead-end (matches ycsd87)
far west SW corner — dead-end (matches vi6hmf)
west-inner staging after the corner turn (matches s6j53l)
center pivot — joins west spine to south bay and east-center (matches v0udx4)
east hub — main east-staging junction (matches hpk1e8)
east entry hub, joins east_gate (matches v7es9b)

traversalNotes: Direct N→E backbone (counterclockwise wrap): spawn_north → north_hub → sw_step1 → sw_step2 → west_hub → west_inner → center → east_center → east_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. TEN hops.
NORTH-BAY CLIQUE (north_bay_nw, north_bay_ne, north_bay_e): three pockets around the north entry — all dispatch via north_hub.
FAR-WEST CORNERS (west_far_n, west_far_s): single-degree dead-end pockets off west_hub. Likely objective spots.
SOUTH BAY (south_bay): triangular detour connected to both center and east_center.
EAST POCKET (east_pocket): detour between east_hub and east_inner; not a shortcut to spawn_east since both ends already connect to east_inner.

DISPATCH RULE: each sub-zone's objectives route via its hub anchor (north_hub for north bay, west_hub for far-west corners, east_hub for east pocket). Backbone is strict-backbone — don't emit cross-zone shortcuts.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
